principles: M0 records current prompt facts before editing prompt bodies.
Mechanical verification must be stronger than prose review for hashes, role count, output hashes, and forbidden-pattern regressions.
Existing legacy/direct-story references should be visible and classified in the baseline rather than silently cleaned up in the wrong milestone.
The check must consume package prompt registry facts and agent_prompt output, not a hand-maintained role list alone.
drivers: The execution plan requires exact 16 prompt filenames and template hashes from promptRegistryManifest().
The execution plan requires agent_prompt output capture for every role.
The execution plan requires role-overlap classification and regression checks for legacy verification vocabulary plus direct docs/story write instructions.
M0 must not implement the later proof-or-stop-* rename or prompt-body consolidation work.

options.name: A: committed baseline JSON/Markdown plus focused verifier script
pros: Keeps M0 scoped to inventory and regression evidence
Produces reviewable artifacts for every prompt
Can be wired into npm test without changing prompt runtime behavior
cons: Later prompt-edit milestones must update the baseline intentionally

options.name: B: add runtime registry enforcement now
pros: Could prevent some bad prompt states earlier
cons: Bleeds into M0.5/M1 responsibilities and changes runtime behavior before baseline freeze

options.name: C: prose-only report in the decision doc
cons: Does not mechanically prove hashes, agent_prompt output, or regression coverage

chosen: A: committed baseline JSON/Markdown plus focused verifier script
rationale: A satisfies M0 exit criteria while preserving the no-prompt-body-edit boundary. It gives later milestones an explicit lockfile to update when they intentionally rename or consolidate prompts, and it makes existing legacy/direct-story issues visible without changing prompt semantics in M0.

preMortem.scenario: The baseline script duplicates the registry logic and drifts from the real prompt source.
preMortem.trigger: A prompt template changes but the script reads a separate hand-maintained list.
preMortem.consequence: M0 reports stale or incomplete role facts.
preMortem.mitigation: Import the built prompt-registry module and compare against promptRegistryManifest/readPromptRegistry output.

preMortem.scenario: Existing direct docs/story references make the regression check impossible to pass in M0.
preMortem.trigger: The script treats all historical references as new unclassified violations.
preMortem.consequence: M0 would require prompt-body fixes that belong to later milestones.
preMortem.mitigation: Record explicit baseline classifications and fail only when unregistered legacy/direct-write findings appear or when classification no longer matches source facts.

preMortem.scenario: The check is not run by reviewers or future milestones.
preMortem.trigger: Only a document artifact is committed with no command entrypoint.
preMortem.consequence: Prompt changes can bypass the baseline lock.
preMortem.mitigation: Expose node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs and an npm script; run it in this story verification evidence.
